purpose: Determine before outcomes whether the prospectively selected bank calendar contains repeated riders across circumference levels, a prerequisite for separating rider-specific circumference response from pure venue/rider-mix differences.

support_summary.identity_status: NAME_PLUS_PERIOD_PRE_MATCH_ONLY; official registration-number mapping still required under frozen identity contract

design_implication: The prospective calendar has real within-rider cross-circumference support, so Rider×Circumference is not structurally impossible. This does not estimate an effect. Opponent strength, class/race stage, venue, timing, and repeated-rider selection must still be controlled/prespecified, and official identity plus clean PRE gates must pass.
allowed_next: Complete exhaustive PRE roster intersection and official registration-number mapping; quantify support counts before assigning fit/eval or opening outcomes.
